title: Optimal Deterministic First-Order Oracle Complexity for Nonconvex-Concave Minimax Optimization
summary: We study the deterministic first-order oracle complexity of smooth nonconvex-concave minimax optimization over a bounded convex dual domain under two notions of stationarity: optimization stationarity (OS) and game stationarity (GS). OS concerns stationarity of the value function, viewed as a structured nonsmooth objective obtained by maximizing over the dual variable. GS concerns the joint first-order optimality conditions for both primal minimization and dual maximization, each with the other variable held fixed.
